info.title: API.SH: OnPromptAds
info.description: The OnPromptAds API from API.SH: public OnPromptAds data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One OnPromptAds collection (a prompt bundle): title, description, creator, price, the individual total and discount, and its prompts in full (title, AI tool, category, tags, images, stats; prompt text when public).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/onpromptads-collection

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Prompt collections (bundles) on OnPromptAds, as on the browse page's Collections tab: `id`, `url`, `title`, `description`, `creator`, `price`, `individual_total_price`, `discount_percentage`, `prompt_count`, `prompt_ids` (each works with `/onpromptads/v1/prompt`), `cover_image`, `reviews`, `is_active`, `created_at`, `updated_at` and `raw`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/onpromptads-collections

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` from the previous response; null on the last page.

get.description:
One OnPromptAds prompt: every field of `/onpromptads/v1/prompts` plus `prompt_preview` (the opening of the prompt the site shows publicly), `ratings` (reviews), `collections` (bundles that contain it), `blog_posts` and `related` prompts. The full prompt text needs an OnPromptAds account for most prompts, so `prompt_text` is null for those and `prompt_preview` holds the public part. Unknown prompts answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/onpromptads-prompt

parameters.name: slug
parameters.description: The prompt's `slug` or `id` from `/onpromptads/v1/prompts`, or its page URL (`onpromptads.com/prompts/<slug>/`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
AI prompts from the OnPromptAds library (onpromptads.com/prompts), with the browse page's filters and sorts: search text, the Ads / Non Ads tabs (`type`), category, AI tool, tags, free or paid, price range, rating range and publish dates. `total` and `total_pages` are the site's counts. Each prompt: `id`, `slug`, `url`, `title`, `description`, `prompt_type`, `ai_tool`, `category`, `tags`, `preview_image`, `media` (example images and videos), `prompt_text` (null when the site asks visitors to sign in for it, which is most prompts), `prompt_word_count`, `prompt_text_locked`, `price`, `is_free`, `is_premium_only`, `is_featured`, `views`, `likes`, `downloads`, `rating`, `rating_count`, `creator` (id, username, name, profile URL), `usage_instructions`, `created_at`, `published_at`, `updated_at` and `raw`. With `q` set, the site's search ignores `tags`, the price and rating ranges and the dates, and returns no prompts when `ai_tool` is also given. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. Use a prompt's `slug` with `/onpromptads/v1/prompt`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/onpromptads-prompts

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The page's tabs: `ads` (advertising categories), `non_ads` (fun, social media, creative art, portrait, nature, education) or `all` (default). Ignored when `category` is set.

parameters.name: ai_tool
parameters.description: Only prompts written for this AI tool.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated tag slugs (as in a prompt's `tags`); prompts with any of them, e.g. `cinematic-lighting,8k-uhd`.

parameters.name: price
parameters.description: Only free or only paid prompts.

parameters.name: date_from
parameters.description: Published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: date_to
parameters.description: Published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort direction (default `desc`; `price` with `asc` is cheapest first).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` from the previous response; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
